title: Naa Snehithuda – Prabhu Pammi, Jessy Paul Telugu Christian Lyrics

credits.Lyrics: Divya David, Dr. Pammi Daniel, Prabhu Pammi

intro: Naa Snehithuda is the latest Christian Telugu Christmas song written by Divya David, Dr. Pammi Daniel, Prabhu Pammi tuned, composed, produced & sung by Telugu Christian Gospel Singer, music director, worship leader, Prabhu Pammi featuring Jessy Paul. This song was released on October 31, 2021 through Yireh Music YouTube channel.
